d.ko: A procedural first-person horror adventure. You are on your own after something goes terribly wrong in this top-secret containment facility. Collect items to aid in your escape and try to uncover the truth, as horror lurks behind every door. Can you make it out alive?
d.en: A procedural first-person horror adventure. You are on your own after something goes terribly wrong in this top-secret containment facility. Collect items to aid in your escape and try to uncover the truth, as horror lurks behind every door. Can you make it out alive?
d.zh: 一款第一人称恐怖冒险游戏。这个绝密设施中出了大问题，而你只能孤身一人。收集物品帮助你逃脱，并尝试揭开真相——因为恐怖正潜伏在每一扇门后。你能活着逃出去吗？
